256.literal: Knock it off—there's no way that's true.
256.official: Come on, quit busting my balls.

257.official: Hey, Kiryu... What's it like having zero sense of rhythm?

258.literal: Don't get so down about it! Everything's just practice!
258.official: Aw, don't let it get you down. It's all just practice!

259.literal: Still, belting it out like that really worked up an appetite.
259.official: All that singing worked up an appetite.

260.literal: Wanna go grab some ramen to cap it all off?
260.official: How about we move this party to the ramen shop?

261.literal: You planning to eat even more?

264.literal: I figured maybe you were a regular here.
264.official: I thought maybe you were a regular.

265.literal: You could learn a thing or two from me.
265.official: you could stand to follow my lead a little

266.literal: So you're just not that type, then.
266.official: But I guess you're just not the type, huh?

267.literal: Me... I've just been chasing after the old man's back,
267.official: I... I entered this life chasing after Kazama-san.

268.literal: The only thing I'm good for is putting my body on the line.
268.official: all I can give is my life

269.literal: There's that way of turning out, too.

270.literal: It's just that you're not Kazama's kid.

271.literal: You're a member of the Dojima Family.

272.literal: Cut it out... The old man had his reasons for doing it.

273.literal: All right! Enough with the serious talk!

275.literal: Don't tell me this was on Captain Kazama's orders?
275.official: This wouldn't happen to be a case of Captain Kazama pulling the strings, would it?

276.literal: And where'd you get that piece?
276.official: And where did you get a piece?

277.literal: The body they found had been beaten up, and then—
277.official: The body they found was beat to hell,

278.literal: —it was finished off with a shot to the head.
278.official: but it was a bullet to the face that ended him.

279.literal: The cops haven't made it public yet, though.
279.official: The police haven't made that public yet,

280.literal: In that case, I'm not the one who dumped the body!
280.official: Then it wasn't me that killed him.

281.literal: He told me to rough him up a bit first and then collect the money.
281.official: so I could teach him a lesson and collect the cash

282.literal: What you just said—no mistake about it, right?

283.literal: That said, the fact that our family was involved in that killing—
283.official: Still, doesn't change the fact that one of our boys was involved in the killin'.

284.official: doesn't change the fact that one of our boys was involved in the killin'

285.literal: At this rate, it'll get in the way of 'that other job.'

286.official: I've seen this place a million times, but it never looked as scary as it does now.

288.literal: The boss... is Boss Dojima in the office?
288.official: Is the boss... Is Dojima in today?

289.literal: ...Tell him Kazuma Kiryu has come to return his cup.
289.official: Tell him... Kazuma Kiryu is here to end his oath.

291.literal: I'll try to handle it as deftly as I can.
291.official: I'll try to finesse it, like you would.

292.official: Please let me through to see him.

293.literal: Ahh, too bad. Saturday at eight is no good.
293.official: Yeah, that's a shame. Saturdays at eight's bad timing.

294.literal: Wha—you... you haven't even cut off your pinky.
294.official: The hell? Your pinky's still on your goddamn hand.

295.literal: You bastard—you taking the yakuza lightly, huh?!
295.official: That's not how things work in the yakuza, dumbass!

296.literal: Hey, think it over again, Kiryu.
296.official: C'mon, use your head here, Kiryu.

297.literal: Do it now and I'll wipe the whole slate clean.
297.official: It's not too late to put this all behind us.

298.literal: Get the info on the 'Empty Lot' out of Captain Kazama.
298.official: Pump Captain Kazama for that info on the Empty Lot.

299.literal: So the answer's no, then? Heh, I see...
299.official: So that's a no, then? Heh, all right...

300.literal: So you're saying you're of no use to me, then?
300.official: I've got no use left for you.

301.official: You had the chance to climb the ranks as one of my boys.

302.literal: It's not flashy, but burying him alive up in the mountains would be best, I'd say.
302.official: It's not fancy, but a live burial up in the mountains is probably easiest.

303.literal: Yeah, leave the body. It's better if his corpse turns up later on—
303.official: No, leave a body. It's better if he's found, down the line.

304.literal: —it'll boost our standing with the main family, too.

305.literal: Captain Kazama sure scouted himself a fine kid.
305.official: Kazama scouted himself a solid kid.

306.literal: If I'd met you back when I was still boxing,
306.official: If I'd met you back when I was boxing,

307.literal: I'd practically want to be your promoter.
307.official: I'd have offered to be your promoter.

308.literal: Kuze... spit it out before you lose the ability to talk.
308.official: Kuze... Talk, before I break your jaw.

310.literal: Kiryu... you went through all this trouble because you wanted out of the family—
310.official: Tell me, Kiryu. Why go through all this to get kicked out?

311.official: In order to prove that me and Kazama-san are innocent, sir.

312.literal: —that's what I'm here to make clear.
312.official: In order to prove that me and Kazama-san are innocent, sir.

313.literal: In this whole affair, I didn't do the killing.
313.official: I'm not the one who killed that man,

314.literal: Well then, shall we grab a bite to eat.

315.literal: The culprit? The cops'll go looking for him on their own.
315.official: The killer? Let the police sort that out.

316.literal: It's way too late to be yapping on and on about it now.
316.official: Get it through your head and stop whining.

317.literal: That's why I asked to be expelled.
317.official: So you asked to be expelled.

318.literal: Relax. I'll make sure amends are settled properly.
318.official: Well, relax. I'll make sure responsibility's taken.

319.literal: The kid Kazama picked up off the street... Kiryu, because of your blunder—
319.official: Your screw-up made it harder for us to get that land, Kiryu. And it was Kazama that brought you in.
